instruction: HTML input form nama
output:
```html
<form><label>Nama: <input name="nama"></label><button>Hantar</button></form>
```
Label membalut input supaya klik teks fokus medan (aksesibiliti asas); atribut `name` tentukan kunci data dihantar.

instruction: Which semantic HTML tags should I use?
output: Structure with `<header> <nav> <main> <article> <section> <aside> <footer>` instead of div soup — screen readers and search engines understand the outline. One `<h1>` per page, headings in order without skipping levels. Semantics first, divs only when no tag fits.

instruction: How do I validate forms without JavaScript?
output:
```html
<input required minlength="3" pattern="[A-Za-z ]+" title="Nama sahaja">
<input type="email" required>
```
Native `required`, `type=email|number|date`, `pattern` and `minlength` block bad submits with localized messages. Always re-validate server-side — client checks are UX, not security.

instruction: How do I make images fast and accessible?
output: ```html ``` `alt` describes content for screen readers (empty alt for decorative), `srcset` serves right sizes, `loading="lazy"` defers offscreen images.

instruction: HTML accessibility quick wins?
output: Label every input, keep color contrast 4.5:1+, make all actions keyboard-reachable with visible `:focus` styles, and use `aria-*` only when native tags fall short (`aria-label` on icon buttons). Test by tabbing through the page blindfolded... almost — keyboard only, no mouse.

instruction: Essential head tags for SEO?
output:
```html
<title>Blog XCoder — Tutorial Docker</title>
<meta name="description" content="...140 aksara...">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://contoh.my/blog/docker">
<meta property="og:title" content="...">
```
Unique title + description per page, canonical URL against duplicates, Open Graph tags for social previews. Content quality still outranks meta tweaks.

instruction: script defer vs async?
output: Both load without blocking parse: `async` runs the moment it arrives (order random — for independent widgets), `defer` runs in order after parsing (for dependent app code). Plain scripts in head block rendering — default to `defer` at end of body needs neither. Modules (`type="module"`) are deferred by default.

instruction: How do heading levels work in HTML?
output: Satu `<h1>` per halaman (tajuk utama), susun `<h2>`→`<h3>` tanpa lompat — pembaca skrin navigasi mengikut outline ini. Lompat h1→h3 mengelirukan; gaya visual via CSS, bukan pilih tahap ikut saiz.

instruction: When do I use ul, ol or dl?
output: `<ul>` senarai tidak tertib (ciri, menu), `<ol>` tertib bermakna (langkah, ranking — `start`/`reversed` tersedia), `<dl>` pasangan istilah-takrifan (`<dt>`/`<dd>` untuk glosari/FAQ). Pilih ikut makna, bukan bullet yang diingini.

output: ```html Luar ``` `target="_blank"` tanpa `rel="noopener"` beri halaman baharu akses `window.opener` (tabnabbing). Pautan dalaman kekal tab sama — hormati butang belakang pengguna.

instruction: How do figure and figcaption work?
output: ```html ``` Figure ikat media dengan kapsyennya secara semantik — pembaca skrin umumkan hubungan. Guna untuk gambar rajah, petikan kod dan contoh, bukan setiap gambar hiasan.

instruction: How do video and audio tags work?
output:
```html
<video controls preload="metadata" width="640">
  <source src="demo.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  Maaf, pelayar anda tidak sokong video.
</video>
```
Sentiasa `controls` (kecuali pemain tersuai penuh), `preload="metadata"` elak muat berat automatik, teks fallback untuk pelayar lama. Sediakan kapsyen `<track kind="captions">` untuk aksesibiliti.

instruction: How do iframes work safely?
output:
```html
<iframe src="https://peta.contoh.my" loading="lazy" sandbox="allow-scripts" title="Peta"></iframe>
```
`sandbox` sekat skrip/borang/pop timbul melainkan dibenar eksplisit; `loading="lazy"` tangguh luar skrin; `title` wajib untuk pembaca skrin. Iframe pihak ketiga adalah lubang prestasi dan privasi — audit perlu.

instruction: Why do lang and dir attributes matter?
output:
```html
<html lang="ms" dir="ltr">
```
`lang` pandu pembaca skrin sebutan betul + enjin carian mensasar bahasa; `dir="rtl"` untuk Arab/Ibrani susun semula aliran. Tetapkan di `<html>`, timpa per bahagian (`<span lang="en">`) untuk petikan asing.

instruction: How do favicons work in 2026?
output:
```html
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/ikon-180.png">
```
Satu SVG cukup untuk pelayar moden (skala sempurna); tambah PNG 180px untuk Apple dan `manifest.json` untuk Android. Letak di root (`/favicon.ico` fallback automatik).
